sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Escha-W2 is a 2-bit quantized variant of Qwen3.8-27B maintained by EschaLabs, a company specializing in extreme quantization. The model contains the full 27 billion parameter count compressed into 10.15 GB of weights using mixed 2/3-bit quantization (2.469 bits per weight average) with int8 embeddings and head layers.

sources.snippet: Escha Labs — extreme low-bit model compression. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Escha-W2 is a 35B-parameter model in 12.3 GB that holds 100.2% of its FP8 baseline's mean across six capability benchmarks and decodes 225 tok/s on one RTX 4090.
